verdict.rationale: Bun, as a package manager, has no product concept of user-defined automations that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. This story belongs to automation or workflow platforms, so it is a category error here. The lockfile, `--frozen-lockfile` and `bun pm` diff features govern dependency versions, not automations, and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
